column1: # Mega reconcile labels: the one declaration of what `mega.sh status` prints per sub-goal row.
# Readers: lib/mega/mega.sh (_label, the `labels` verb) and lib/mega/mega-review.py (the status-line parser).
# tests/test-mega-labels.sh proves a row added here reaches both with no second edit.
# Columns are TAB-separated: class, label, kind.
#   label  the text printed in the status line.
#   kind   status    a label the status line carries and `mega review` parses; order is the order printed by `mega.sh labels`.
#          fallback  printed for an unknown class; never parsed.
